questions.question: Correct or explain the place and date on the cover: its calendar reads “Vienna 1934”, whereas the article and biographical sources place Bergman at Tomsk University in 1934–1936; his studies in Vienna ended much earlier. The cover label and the RU/EN descriptions must be reconciled. Sources: https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Biographies/Bergman/ and https://www.deutsche-biographie.de/dbo010680-5.html?language=en
